deck.editability: hybrid-editable: 776 native PowerPoint text boxes over a rendered, text-free design background at a 1920x1080 stage. Titles, stats, table cells, card copy and notes are click-and-retype in Space Grotesk / IBM Plex Sans / JetBrains Mono. Design furniture (panels, rails, wafer grid, bar geometry, die motif) stays in the background image and is edited at source via build_deck.py + template.css + theme.css.
